ecb_gfs_residual_maturity.title: Government finance statistics: average residual maturity of general government debt securities, Germany (series GFS.M.N.DE.W0.S13.S1.N.L.LE.F3.TT._Z.YR._T.F.V.A1._T)
ecb_gfs_residual_maturity.note: December 2024: 8.15 years (8.1482; non-consolidated, outstanding amounts). September 2026: 8.30 years. Retrieved through the ECB data API.

ecb_gfs_debt_maturity.title: Government finance statistics: general government debt by residual maturity and with variable interest rate, Germany, percent of government debt
ecb_gfs_debt_maturity.note: 2024: residual maturity up to 1 year 17.76 %, over 1 and up to 5 years 33.41 %, over 5 years 48.84 % of the debt; long-term debt with a variable interest rate 6.61 %. Series GD.TS, GD.TY15, GD.TY5_ and GDA.L with unit XDC_R_GD.

bundesbank_yield_curve_daily.title: Term structure of interest rates on listed Federal securities (method by Svensson), daily data, residual maturities of 1 to 30 years
bundesbank_yield_curve_daily.note: 18 November 2026: 3.01 % (1 year), 3.12 % (2 years), 3.18 % (5 years), 3.43 % (10 years), 3.72 % (20 years), 3.82 % (30 years). The link is the 10-year series; the other maturities replace R10XX with R01XX, R02XX, R05XX, R20XX and R30XX.

bundesbank_yield_10y_monthly.title: Term structure of interest rates on listed Federal securities (method by Svensson), residual maturity of 10 years, monthly data

us_treasury_yields_2026_11.title: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, November 2026
us_treasury_yields_2026_11.note: 10-year par yield: 5.07 % on 18 November 2026 (5.10 % on 17 November).

ameco_2026_11.title: AMECO annual macro-economic database, release of 17 November 2026 (autumn 2026 forecast)
ameco_2026_11.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Economic and Financial Affairs
ameco_2026_11.note: General government, percent of GDP, 2024: interest under the excessive deficit procedure (UYIGE) and consolidated gross debt (UDGG): United States 4.71 and 123.27, Italy 3.87 and 134.25, France 2.05 and 112.63, Japan 1.22 and 213.59, Germany 1.05 and 61.42. Germany 1995: 3.50 and 54.89; 2010: 2.44 and 81.03 (UYIGE, UDGGL). Total revenue (URTG), same unit: United States 31.44, Italy 46.90, France 51.23, Japan 36.89 and Germany 46.24 in 2024; Germany 45.80 in 1995 and 43.71 in 2010. Germany, nominal GDP (UVGD) 2025 to 2028: 4,529.7, 4,716.0, 4,910.9 and 5,090.2 billion euros; potential GDP (OVGDP) grows by 0.5 to 0.6 % a year. Chapter files 6, 16 and 18 of the download.

bmf_tragfaehigkeitsbericht_2024.title: Sechster Bericht zur Tragfähigkeit der öffentlichen Finanzen, Drucksache 20/11235 vom 22. April 2024
bmf_tragfaehigkeitsbericht_2024.publisher: Deutscher Bundestag (Unterrichtung durch die Bundesregierung; Bundesministerium der Finanzen)
bmf_tragfaehigkeitsbericht_2024.note: Age-related spending 27.3 % of GDP in 2022, 2070: 36.1 % (variant T-) and 30.8 % (T+); debt ratio in 2070 about 365 % and 140 % of GDP. Real GDP growth 0.6 % (2040) and 0.4 % (2070) in T-, 1.5 % and 1.6 % in T+; inflation 2.0 % from 2025; interest on new debt rising to 4 % by 2035; starting point a primary balance of +0.1 % of GDP in 2027 (pages 7 to 8, 25 to 27).

tfeu_protocol_12.title: Protocol (No 12) on the excessive deficit procedure, Article 1
tfeu_protocol_12.note: Reference values: 3 % of GDP for the planned or actual government deficit, 60 % of GDP for government debt.

estg_10.title: Einkommensteuergesetz, § 10 Sonderausgaben
estg_10.note: Contributions to the statutory pension insurance are deductible as special expenses (Abs. 1 Nr. 2), 100 % from 2023, up to the maximum contribution to the miners' pension insurance (Abs. 3); the tax-free employer share is deducted from the deduction. Basic health and long-term care insurance contributions are deductible in full (Abs. 1 Nr. 3, Abs. 4), reduced by 4 % where they give an entitlement to sick pay.

bt_drs_17_2885.title: Antwort der Bundesregierung: Steuerausfälle durch Beitragserhöhungen in der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung, Drucksache 17/2885 vom 08.09.2010
bt_drs_17_2885.note: Raising the health insurance contribution rate by 0.6 points (about EUR 6 billion, half from the insured) costs about EUR 590 million of income tax and EUR 30 million of solidarity surcharge a year, because employees deduct their contributions as special expenses. Higher employer contributions are deductible business expenses too, but employers try to pass the cost on, so the government gives no figure for them. Marginal burden of a single employee earning EUR 40,000: about 35 % (wage tax plus surcharge).

bundestag_drs_21_7301.title: Finanzplan des Bundes 2026 bis 2030, Drucksache 21/7301 vom 14. August 2026
bundestag_drs_21_7301.publisher: Deutscher Bundestag (Unterrichtung durch die Bundesregierung; Bundesministerium der Finanzen)
bundestag_drs_21_7301.note: Adopted by the federal cabinet on 6 July 2026 together with the draft budget 2027. 'Handlungsbedarf' (gap not yet covered by measures, booked as a global spending cut in section 60): about EUR 22 billion in 2028, 39 billion in 2029 and 48 billion in 2030; the 2027 gap of 34 billion in the previous plan is closed (section 3.3, page 19; also page 9). Federal interest spending, chapter 3205: 41.9 billion in 2027, 55.2 in 2028, 68.1 in 2029, 80.7 in 2030 (section 4.4.1, page 40); by type of spending 29.9 (2025 outturn), 30.2, 41.8, 55.1, 68.0, 80.6 (table 9, page 25). Spending 555.4 billion in 2027 (table 3, page 8). Exemption from the debt brake under Art. 115 (2) sentence 4 GG, created by the amendment of 24 March 2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 94), and the spending it covers: section 4.2, table 10, pages 26 to 27 (2028: defence 153.2 billion, civil protection 2.7, intelligence services 2.8, IT protection 4.0, aid to states attacked in breach of international law 8.5, less 1 % of GDP 46.0).

bundestag_drs_21_9010.title: Bericht des Stabilitätsrates gemäß § 9 des Stabilitätsratsgesetzes: 36. Sitzung am 12. Oktober 2026, Drucksache 21/9010 vom 3. November 2026
bundestag_drs_21_9010.publisher: Deutscher Bundestag (Unterrichtung durch die Bundesregierung; Stabilitätsrat, Bundesministerium der Finanzen)
bundestag_drs_21_9010.note: Advance version. Projection of general government finances by the Federal Ministry of Finance, as of 3 September 2026 (table 1, page 13; also page 23): Maastricht balance -3.0 % of GDP in 2025, then -4 3/4, -5 1/4, -4 3/4, -4 1/2 and -4 1/2 % in 2026 to 2030; Maastricht debt 62.8 % in 2025, then 65 3/4, 68 3/4, 72 1/4, 75 1/4 and 78 1/4 %. Interest of the federal government, Länder and municipalities with off-budget entities, without social insurance, in cash: 52.1, 64 1/2, 69, 84, 99 and 124 billion euros in 2025 to 2030 (page 25). Federal 'Handlungsbedarf' plus savings not yet assigned to measures: 33 1/2, 49 1/2 and 58 billion euros in 2028 to 2030 (page 16). Nominal GDP growth 3.3, 2.8, 3.8, 3.0 and 3.0 % in 2025 to 2030 (table 6, page 21).

bt_drs_21_9241.title: Beschlussempfehlung und Bericht des Haushaltsausschusses zu dem Gesetzentwurf der Bundesregierung: Entwurf eines Haushaltsbegleitgesetzes 2027, Drucksache 21/9241 vom 16.11.2026 (Vorabfassung)
bt_drs_21_9241.note: Adopted on 13 November 2026 with the votes of CDU/CSU and SPD. Inserts the Sugar-Sweetened Drinks Tax Act as new Article 1: EUR 0.25, 0.30 and 0.35 per litre at 5 to under 7, 7 to under 9 and 9 or more grams of sugar per 100 ml, from 1 January 2028 (p. 10); full-year revenue EUR 1,115 m in 2028, 1,120 m in 2029, 1,130 m in 2030 and 1,135 m in 2031, all federal (p. 57); customs and IT costs about EUR 90 m up to 2029, 200 customs staff (pp. 55 to 56); the tax counter-finances the smaller cut of the federal subsidy to the health fund in the GKV contribution stabilisation act (pp. 49 and 53). Drops the abolition of the immediate supplement in the child supplement (p. 2); cuts the federal pension subsidy in 2027 by a further EUR 3.0 bn, EUR 4.2 bn in total (p. 107); keeps standard benefits unchanged until 30 June 2028 (pp. 107 to 108); alcohol, intermediate products and alcopop taxes EUR 470 m a year, of which spirits EUR 385 m and alcopops EUR 80 m (pp. 109 to 110); positions of the parliamentary groups (pp. 49 to 52).

bmf_pm_zuckergetraenkesteuer_2026.title: Bundeskabinett bringt Gesetzentwurf für Zuckergetränkesteuer auf den Weg (Pressemitteilung, 14. Oktober 2026)
bmf_pm_zuckergetraenkesteuer_2026.note: Cabinet's draft for the coalition groups: two rates, EUR 0.26 per litre at 5 to under 8 g of sugar per 100 ml and EUR 0.32 from 8 g, from 1 July 2027; additional federal revenue EUR 690 m in 2027, 925 m in 2028 and 875 to 890 m a year after that; revenue meant to keep health insurance contributions stable; exemption for small producers up to 70,000 litres a year, relief up to 1 million litres subject to EU state aid approval; health costs of sugary drinks put at about EUR 2.1 bn a year.

wd4_zuckersteuer_2026.title: Fragen zur geplanten Einführung einer Zuckersteuer, WD 4 - 30000 - 0003 - 0009 (Abschluss der Arbeit: 20. August 2026)
wd4_zuckersteuer_2026.note: Pages 4 to 6: the revenue of a sugar tax goes to the federal level alone (Article 106(1) No. 2 Basic Law); the Health Finance Commission recommended the British model with 26 and 32 cents per litre; the health committee's report on the GKV contribution stabilisation act (Drucksache 21/7016, 8 July 2026, p. 209) expected EUR 650 m in 2027 and, after reformulation, EUR 450 m a year from 2028.

dpa_plastiksteuer_entwurf_2026.title: Gesetzentwurf: Koalitionsfraktionen planen neue Plastiksteuer (dpa, 5. Oktober 2026)
dpa_plastiksteuer_entwurf_2026.note: Draft Plastic Packaging Tax Act (Kunststoffverpackungsteuergesetz) of the finance and environment ministries, to be introduced by the coalition groups: EUR 550 per tonne of plastic in packaging with a plastic share of more than 5%, from July 2027; about 3 million tonnes taxable at first, expected to fall; EUR 805 m in 2027 and about EUR 1.5 bn a year from 2028; packaging of recycled plastic can be exempted on application. No published version of the draft could be found as of 19 November 2026.

tonline_plastiksteuer_2026.title: Haushalt 2027: Frei erklärt die geplante Plastiksteuer für tot (dpa, Reuters, 9. November 2026)
tonline_plastiksteuer_2026.note: CDU/CSU group leader Thorsten Frei on ZDF: "Die Plastiksteuer machen wir nicht"; SPD group leader Matthias Miersch: not off the table, a first draft exists; planned revenue EUR 805 m in 2027 and just under EUR 1.5 bn a year from 2028.

adhoc_dpa_zuckersteuer_2028.title: Haushalt 2027: Zuckersteuer kommt erst ab Januar 2028 (dpa, 12. November 2026)
adhoc_dpa_zuckersteuer_2028.note: Coalition agreement before the final committee session: sugar tax postponed by half a year to 1 January 2028, in three rates; the planned tax on plastic packaging dropped (Thorsten Frei: the draft offered no unbureaucratic solution); no increase of the sparkling wine tax; parental allowance still being negotiated; electricity tax cut for everyone (about EUR 5 bn a year) still open.

bundestag_kw46_haushalt_2027.title: Bereinigungssitzung: Ausschuss beschließt Bundeshaushalt 2027 (Textarchiv, November 2026)
bundestag_kw46_haushalt_2027.note: Final session of the budget committee on 12 and 13 November 2026: spending EUR 560.92 bn, net borrowing EUR 122.97 bn, of which EUR 84.55 bn under the exemption for defence; defence budget EUR 109.75 bn; changes to the Budget Accompanying Act (sugar tax from 2028, federal pension subsidy cut by a further EUR 2 bn, standard benefits adjusted on 1 July, next on 1 July 2028); final vote in the Bundestag scheduled for 27 November 2026.

ec_plastics_own_resource.title: Plastics own resource
ec_plastics_own_resource.note: Since 1 January 2021 member states contribute EUR 0.80 per kilogram of non-recycled plastic packaging waste to the EU budget; how they reduce such waste is left to them.

bmbfsfj_refe_elterngeld_2026.title: Referentenentwurf: Entwurf eines Gesetzes zur Änderung des Bundeselterngeld- und Elternzeitgesetzes zur Weiterentwicklung und Vereinfachung des Elterngeldes sowie des Mutterschutzgesetzes (Bearbeitungsstand 10.11.2026)
bmbfsfj_refe_elterngeld_2026.publisher: Bundesministerium für Bildung, Familie, Senioren, Frauen und Jugend
bmbfsfj_refe_elterngeld_2026.note: Section D (pp. 3 to 4): federal savings in parental allowance of EUR 60 m in 2027, 535 m in 2028, 1,330 m in 2029 and 1,360 m in 2030 (full effect), none for states and municipalities; within it, counting one-off pay in the assessment costs EUR 140 m and abolishing the partnership bonus saves EUR 25 m in 2030. Replacement rate 80% in each parent's first four months and 50% after, instead of usually 65%; minimum EUR 330 instead of 300, maximum EUR 1,900 instead of 1,800.

bundesregierung_kabinett_elterngeld_2026.title: Kabinett: Reform von Elterngeld und Mutterschutz (13. November 2026)
bundesregierung_kabinett_elterngeld_2026.note: Adopted by the cabinet by written procedure: up to 14 months together, four reserved for each parent at 80% of prior income, further months at 50%; minimum EUR 330, maximum EUR 1,900; parallel receipt again unrestricted; from 1 November 2027. No fiscal figures.

hib_654_2026.title: hib 654/2026: Haushalt 2027: Weniger Ausgaben für Bildung und Familie (19. August 2026)
hib_654_2026.note: Draft budget 2027, section 17: parental allowance about EUR 7.07 bn (2026: 7.51 bn), child supplement about EUR 3.12 bn (2026: 3.38 bn), advance maintenance payments EUR 914 m (2026: 1.31 bn).

vdw_bayern_koalitionsausschuss_2026.title: Beschluss des Koalitionsausschusses vom 17. November 2026: Senkung der Stromsteuer (18. November 2026)
vdw_bayern_koalitionsausschuss_2026.note: Reproduces the text of the decision: the electricity tax is reduced to the European minimum, at first for 2027 only, and financed in 2027 from room in the EEG title of the federal budget, otherwise by a package of measures during the year; continuing beyond 31 December 2027 requires sustainable counter-financing in the 2028 budget; a permanent reduction is intended.

tonline_stromsteuer_2026_11.title: Stromsteuer: Koalition beschließt Senkung – mit einem Haken (18. November 2026)
tonline_stromsteuer_2026_11.note: Coalition committee: electricity tax at 0.1 instead of 2.05 cents per kWh for everyone from 1 January to 31 December 2027; cost about EUR 5.4 bn (dpa); financed from savings in the EEG title; the law still has to be passed.

tonline_frei_haushalt_2028.title: Frei sieht gewaltige Herausforderungen für Bundeshaushalt (dpa, 19. November 2026)
tonline_frei_haushalt_2028.note: CDU/CSU group leader Thorsten Frei: as things stand, a gap of EUR 25 bn in the 2028 budget, about EUR 5 bn larger with the electricity tax cut.

dpa_klingbeil_abgeltungsteuer_2026.title: SPD-Chef Klingbeil will von CDU mehr Tempo bei Reformen (dpa, 14. November 2026)
dpa_klingbeil_abgeltungsteuer_2026.note: Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil (SPD) names a higher flat tax on capital income as one option to finance the electricity tax cut for everyone (about EUR 5.4 bn a year), without naming a rate, and expects the Union to reject it.

haufe_plastiksteuer_2026.title: Was bedeutet die geplante Plastiksteuer (13. Oktober 2026)
haufe_plastiksteuer_2026.note: Describes the draft Plastic Packaging Tax Act: EUR 550 per tonne of plastic, taxpayers are domestic manufacturers, importers and buyers from other EU states, with notification duty, monthly tax returns and no de minimis threshold; relief for recycled plastic applies only once a regulation with a proof system exists, for which the draft sets no date.

bt_drs_21_8495.title: Kleine Anfrage der Fraktion der AfD: Elterngeldreform 2027 – Auswirkungen der Haushaltskonsolidierung auf Familien, Drucksache 21/8495 vom 12.10.2026
bt_drs_21_8495.note: Page 2: the key figures for the 2027 budget list the parental allowance reform among the consolidation steps; appropriation EUR 7.07 bn in the 2027 draft after 7.51 bn in 2026; Family Minister Karin Prien promised in the budget debate on 10 September 2026 that parents already expecting a child would keep their entitlement (Vertrauensschutz).

bt_drs_21_7016.title: Beschlussempfehlung und Bericht des Ausschusses für Gesundheit zu dem Gesetzentwurf der Bundesregierung: Entwurf eines Gesetzes zur Stabilisierung der Beitragssätze in der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung (GKV-Beitragssatzstabilisierungsgesetz), Drucksache 21/7016 vom 08.07.2026 (Vorabfassung)
bt_drs_21_7016.note: Page 6: in the government draft the federal subsidy to the health fund falls by EUR 2.0 bn a year from 2027; a levy on sugar-sweetened drinks (EUR 0.5 bn a year) is listed only for information and not counted in the totals. Page 209: the committee uses the room from a tax on sugary drinks to reduce the cut in the subsidy, assuming tax revenue of EUR 650 m in 2027 and, after reformulation, EUR 450 m a year from 2028.

bt_drs_21_9229.title: Beschlussempfehlung und Bericht des Finanzausschusses zu dem Antrag der Fraktion der AfD: Steuererhöhung auf Tabak zurücknehmen – Keine weiteren Steuern auf Alkohol, Zucker und Plastik – Bagatellsteuern abschaffen, Drucksache 21/9229 vom 13.11.2026 (Vorabfassung)
bt_drs_21_9229.note: The AfD motion (Drucksache 21/8637) asks to reverse the tobacco tax increases before the first step on 1 January 2027, to freeze the alcohol tax, to repeal a sugar tax and not to introduce a plastic tax; the finance committee recommends rejecting it with the votes of CDU/CSU, SPD, Greens and Left against the AfD.
